scripts.text:
You can read on the back of the statue:
'By the spirit of olds, the walls are closed
Upper floors or foreign taboo
By the order of the Statues you will find the way
Which perhaps a day will bring you to me.
.....Thanatos '

scripts.speaker: Thalos
scripts.text: You must find the 2nd Statue now.

scripts.speaker: Thalos
scripts.text: Go search the 2nd Statue!

scripts.speaker: Mediane
scripts.text: Okay, i am warping you to the next floor now.

scripts.speaker: Mediane
scripts.text: You must talk with the Spirit in the 1st Statue.

scripts.speaker: Melkor
scripts.text:
You must find the other Spirits now.
We are 3.

scripts.speaker: Melkor
scripts.text: Go Search, They are in this floor.

scripts.speaker: Zebrus
scripts.text: Keep on this way, There is one Spirit left

scripts.speaker: Zebrus
scripts.text: You seems to be lost, Go back and talk to Melkor.

scripts.speaker: Veriaelle
scripts.text: Okay, i am warping you to the next floor.

scripts.speaker: Veriaelle
scripts.text: You seems to be lost, Go back and talk to Melkor.

scripts.speaker: Throtre
scripts.text:
You got my authorization for the next floor
However, you must show how strong you are to the other Spirits

scripts.speaker: Throtre
scripts.text: Go search, They Can't leave this floor.

scripts.speaker: Klermaz
scripts.text:
Hmm it seems that Throtre allowed you to pass.
Well then you have my blessing, 2 Spirits remaining.

scripts.speaker: Klermaz
scripts.text: You seems to be lost, Go back and talk to Throtre.

scripts.speaker: Mihane
scripts.text: Keep on this way, Only 1 Left.

scripts.speaker: Mihane
scripts.text: Sorry, You must start over from the beginning.

scripts.speaker: Seranes
scripts.text:
Perfect, it seems that the other spirits grants you the access.
I am warping you to the next floor.

scripts.speaker: Seranes
scripts.text: You did not follow the good order, starts again from the beginning.

scripts.speaker: Nox
scripts.text: Fine, 4 Spirits left.

scripts.speaker: Nox
scripts.text: Go search, They can't leave this floor.

scripts.speaker: Vox
scripts.text: Keep on this way, 3 Spirits remaining !

scripts.speaker: Vox
scripts.text: Sorry, Go back and talk to Nox.

scripts.speaker: Hox
scripts.text: You are on the good way, 2 Spirits remaining !

scripts.speaker: Hox
scripts.text: Sorry, Go back and talk to Vox.

scripts.speaker: Dox
scripts.text: Perfect, 1 Spirit left.

scripts.speaker: Dox
scripts.text: Sorry, Go back and talk to Hox.

scripts.speaker: Sox
scripts.text: You have just passed the test successfully.

scripts.speaker: Sox
scripts.text: You have to give me Red Magic Stone, Yellow Magic Stone, Blue Magic Stone & Green Magic Stone.

scripts.speaker: Sox
scripts.text:
I will now warp you to steps of Fate.
Good-bye.

scripts.speaker: Sox
scripts.text: Oh well, seems you don't have enough stones.

scripts.speaker: Sox
scripts.text: Sorry, Go back and talk to Dox.
